Definition: UI-produced structured record describing one validated editor change, consumed by the operation_applier seam.
Top-level result document (document_kind openpipestress.desktop.operation_outcome) returned by validate/apply.
Deterministic before/after preview rows produced by validation without mutating the model.
Honest record of a user-initiated local-session acceptance basis; never a professional approval.
Hash-binding evidence echoing claimed and backend model hashes with their canonicalizations.
The engine's single canonical JSON form (RFC 8785 / JCS since H5) used for every model hash seam.
Token from the closed structured editor-operation taxonomy classifying the operation (e.g. set_field, create_node).
Closed set of combination evaluation bases: mechanics, result_state_subtraction, range_envelope.
Closed mode tokens for range-envelope combinations: min, max, min_abs, max_abs.
Accepted PKG-02 dimension vocabulary (30 tokens) shared by SPEC §4 and units.schema.yaml.
Restraint direction vocabulary UX, UY, UZ, RX, RY, RZ used by preview model documents.
Classification of editable fields: Text, Number, Quantity, EntityRef, RestraintSet.
A diagnostic of severity 'blocking' that prevents application; blocked operations are findings, not silent fallbacks.
Checker state indicating the intent failed structural/schema validation.
Per-project unit-system entries (e.g. project.units.length) that supply the unit basis for bare numeric fields.
